account.title: Sync with an optional account
account.subtitle: Sign in to Wursha with Google or Apple to back up your khatmas, adhkar and Tartil playlists, and carry on from your other devices. Signing in is optional; every feature works without it.
items: Sign in with Google on iPhone, iPad and Android, or with Apple on iPhone and iPad.
What syncs: khatmas (reading position, bookmarks and notes), adhkar progress and the adhkar you added, and Tartil favorites, playlists and the selected reciter. Each Mushaf app keeps its own data.
Google or Apple shares your account ID, email address and name with us. We use them only to sign you in and sync your data. We don't sell or share them, and the apps have no ads or tracking.
Delete your account and all of its data at any time: in the app (Account, then Delete account) or on our account deletion page.

privacy.metaDescription: How the Quran Holder and Khair Zad Mushaf apps handle your data: no ads, no tracking, and an optional account for syncing.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy covers the Quran Holder and Khair Zad Mushaf apps by Wursha Digital Apps on iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac and Windows. In short: the apps work without an account, show no ads, contain no analytics or tracking, and we don't sell or share your data.

sections.title: Data on your device
paragraphs: Your settings, khatmas (reading position, bookmarks and notes), athkar progress, Tartil favorites and playlists, and anything you download (recitations, books and databases) are stored only on your device. We don't receive any of it unless you use the optional account. A settings export is a file you create and keep yourself.

sections.title: The optional account
paragraphs: You can sign in with Google or with Apple to back up your data and sync it between your devices. Signing in is optional; every feature works without it.

When you sign in, we receive an account ID, the email address your provider shares (Apple can give a private relay address instead), and your name if the provider shares it. While you are signed in, each Mushaf app syncs its own data, kept separate from the other apps:
items: Khatmas: name, colour, reading position, bookmarks, notes, and the chosen reading and reciter
Athkar: progress, favorites and the athkar you added
Tartil: favorite reciters and surahs, playlists and the selected reciter
Your devices: the type of device (for example iPhone or Android), which app, when it last synced, and a random device ID

sections.title: Who can see account data
paragraphs: Account data is stored on our cloud servers and is encrypted in transit. Only you can read it through the apps. We look at it only to fix a problem you report, or when the law requires it.
We use it only to sync and restore your data. We don't sell it, share it with advertisers, or use it to build a profile of you.

sections.title: Keeping and deleting your data
paragraphs: Account data is kept until you delete it. Khatmas and playlists you delete are removed from our servers 90 days after you delete them.

You can delete your account and all of its data at any time: in the app (Account, then Delete account), at https://wursha.com/delete-account, or by emailing wursha.apps@gmail.com (we reply within 30 days). Deletion is immediate and covers every Mushaf app; the copy on your device stays. If you signed in with Apple, the app's access to your Apple ID is also revoked. An emergency recovery copy, used only to repair a fault, keeps deleted data for up to 7 days; after that it is erased automatically.

sections.title: Internet connections without an account
paragraphs: Some features use the internet. Streaming or downloading recitations, books and databases connects to the servers that host them, such as mp3quran.net and everyayah.com. The desktop apps check for updates. Like any website, these servers see your IP address; the apps send them nothing else about you.

sections.title: Permissions
paragraphs: The apps don't ask for your location, contacts, camera or microphone. When you share a verse as an image you can save the picture to your photo library; the apps never read your photos.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: The apps are suitable for all ages and collect nothing from anyone who doesn't sign in. The optional account is meant for people old enough to have a Google or Apple account where they live.

sections.title: Changes and contact
paragraphs: If this policy changes, we update this page and the date at the top. For questions or requests, email wursha.apps@gmail.com.
